promise: Bring about the return of about 80 percent of Syrians living in Germany within three years
description: In late March 2026, Chancellor Friedrich Merz said he and Syrian President Ahmed al-Sharaa hoped that around 80 percent of the more than 900,000 Syrians residing in Germany would return home over the next three years, a statement that drew criticism from within his own coalition.
evidence: Merz said about 80% of Syrians in Germany are expected to return within three years
Target based on hopes expressed jointly with Syria's President al-Sharaa
